item.name: SETUP - Verify source orders and establish unknown order id

request.description: SETUP ONLY. Verifies persisted source/secondary state and derives an absent order id from observed data.

exec: let ok=false;pm.test("SETUP source orders exist and unknown order id is absent",function(){const rows=pm.response.json();pm.expect(rows).to.be.an("array");const ids=rows.map(o=>Number(o.id)).filter(Number.isFinite),primary=rows.find(o=>Number(o.id)===Number(pm.environment.get("orderUnderTestId"))),secondary=rows.find(o=>Number(o.id)===Number(pm.environment.get("otherOrderId")));pm.expect(primary).to.exist;pm.expect(primary.status).to.eql(pm.iterationData.get("source_state"));pm.expect(secondary).to.exist;pm.expect(secondary.status).to.eql("pending");const candidate=(ids.length?Math.max(...ids):0)+1;pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(candidate);pm.environment.set("unknownOrderId",String(candidate));pm.environment.set("orderStatusSnapshot",JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(rows.map(o=>[String(o.id),o.status]))));ok=true;});pm.environment.set("orderSetupReady",String(ok));if(!ok)pm.environment.set("setupBlockedReason","ORDER_SOURCE_OR_ABSENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED");

if(profile==="TAMPERED_ADMIN"){const t=pm.environment.get("adminToken")||"",parts=t.split(".");if(parts.length!==3||parts.some(p=>!p.length))throw new Error("SETUP_BLOCKED: admin token is not a three-segment JWT");const segment=parts[2],i=Math.floor(segment.length/2),replacement=segment[i]==="a"?"b":"a";parts[2]=segment.slice(0,i)+replacement+segment.slice(i+1);const tampered=parts.join(".");if(tampered===t||tampered.split(".").length!==3)throw new Error("SETUP_BLOCKED: JWT tampering invariant failed");pm.environment.set("tamperedAdminToken",tampered);pm.request.headers.upsert({key:"Authorization",value:"Bearer "+tampered});}

if(mode==="PATH_TARGET_ONLY"){const secondary=rows.find(o=>Number(o.id)===Number(pm.environment.get("otherOrderId")));pm.test("["+scenarioId+"] path-target order changed",function(){pm.expect(order.status).to.eql(target);});pm.test("["+scenarioId+"] body-referenced secondary order stayed unchanged",function(){pm.expect(secondary).to.exist;pm.expect(secondary.status).to.eql("pending");});}

if(mode==="DUPLICATE_STATUS_OBSERVATION"){const snapshot=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("orderStatusSnapshot")||"{}");pm.test("["+scenarioId+"] duplicate-key outcome is parser-justified",function(){pm.expect(["pending","confirmed"]).to.include(order.status);});pm.test("["+scenarioId+"] duplicate-key request does not mutate unrelated orders",function(){rows.filter(o=>Number(o.id)!==id&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(snapshot,String(o.id))).forEach(o=>pm.expect(o.status).to.eql(snapshot[String(o.id)]));});console.log("ORDERSTATUS-EXT-005 parser observation",{persistedStatus:order&&order.status,effectiveValue:order&&order.status==="confirmed"?"first-key confirmed":"last-key delivered safely rejected"});}
